verdict.rationale: Figma exposes multiple APIs (REST, Plugin, MCP) that cover many UI actions—reading objects/layers, webhooks, writing to canvas via MCP/Plugin API, generating code/designs—but the REST API is explicitly read/webhook-oriented (figma-docs-7, figma-docs-26, figma-docs-49) while write access is confined to the Plugin API (which runs inside the Figma editor context) and the MCP server, not a full external API surface. There's no evidence of full parity for things like commenting with images, FigJam games, version history editing, or admin/collaboration features via API. missing for 10: evidence of write/automation parity for comments, FigJam interactive features, version history, and admin controls; independent confirmation that Plugin API can fully replace UI-only actions.
